pages.quiz:
INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Vocabulary means (1 mark)
   A. only names
   B. all the words you know and can use
   C. only long words
   D. the pictures in a book

2. How should you read an interjection aloud? (1 mark)
   A. In a flat voice
   B. Very quietly always
   C. Without pausing
   D. With the feeling it shows

3. What is a panel discussion? (1 mark)
   A. A planned discussion by a small group before an audience
   B. A game of football
   C. A quiz
   D. A solo song

4. The cow eats grass next to the river. Which word means the same as next to? (1 mark)
   A. beside
   B. above
   C. under
   D. inside

5. What does listening for comprehension mean? (1 mark)
   A. Listening only to music
   B. Listening without thinking
   C. Listening while sleeping
   D. Listening to understand and remember

6. Which element tells where and when a story happens? (1 mark)
   A. Title
   B. Setting
   C. Ending
   D. Character

7. How should you collect proverbs from an elder? (1 mark)
   A. Take it without asking
   B. Greet politely and listen to the whole proverb
   C. Interrupt
   D. Refuse to listen

8. Which is a good quality of a leader? (1 mark)
   A. Rudeness
   B. Laziness
   C. Honesty
   D. Cruelty

9. Why do we check a dictionary meaning against the sentence? (1 mark)
   A. Words can have more than one meaning
   B. Dictionaries are wrong
   C. Sentences have no meaning
   D. Words never change

10. What is a proverb? (1 mark)
   A. A type of number
   B. A short wise saying that gives advice
   C. A very long story
   D. A page of a book

11. Fluent reading needs (1 mark)
   A. only a quiet voice
   B. smooth pace, correct words and good expression
   C. only loudness
   D. only speed

12. What is a form? (1 mark)
   A. A page with spaces for information
   B. A story
   C. A picture
   D. A kind of song

13. Why should you underline new words in a text? (1 mark)
   A. To hide them
   B. To count pages
   C. To spoil the book
   D. So you can find their meanings and learn them

14. What is the purpose of the instructions on a form? (1 mark)
   A. To use up space
   B. To tell you how to fill it in
   C. To hide the title
   D. To make it hard

15. Why should you not rush the last lines of a page? (1 mark)
   A. The pen will break
   B. Neatness can be lost when you hurry
   C. The page will run away
   D. It is not allowed

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Explain what the proverb Honesty is the best policy means. (2 marks)

17. Write the verbs in this instruction: Close the door and sit down. (2 marks)

18. Write three sentences describing where things are in your classroom. Use a different preposition in each. (3 marks)

19. Explain why clear instructions are important when it rains. (3 marks)

20. Give two adjectives to describe a mobile phone. (2 marks)

21. Give three rules of good telephone manners. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — all the words you know and can use
   Vocabulary is a person's collection of words.

2. D — With the feeling it shows
   Intonation shows feeling.

3. A — A planned discussion by a small group before an audience
   A panel discusses a topic.

4. A — beside
   Beside and next to both show the side.

5. D — Listening to understand and remember
   Comprehension is understanding.

6. B — Setting
   Setting means place and time.

7. B — Greet politely and listen to the whole proverb
   Politeness and careful listening are important.

8. C — Honesty
   Good leaders are honest and fair.

9. A — Words can have more than one meaning
   The right meaning depends on context.

10. B — A short wise saying that gives advice
   Proverbs teach lessons in a few words.

11. B — smooth pace, correct words and good expression
   These are the parts of fluency.

12. A — A page with spaces for information
   Forms collect information.

13. D — So you can find their meanings and learn them
   Underlining marks the words to study.

14. B — To tell you how to fill it in
   Instructions guide the person filling it.

15. B — Neatness can be lost when you hurry
   Careful writing should stay the same to the end.

SECTION B
----
16. (2 marks)
   Answer: Telling the truth is always the wisest choice because it builds trust.
   Working / marking points: One mark for the meaning and one for the reason.

17. (2 marks)
   Answer: close, sit
   Working / marking points: One mark for each verb.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: Any three correct sentences, for example The board is in front of the class. My bag is under my desk. The teacher stands beside the door.
   Working / marking points: One mark for each correct sentence.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: Clear instructions tell people what to do to stay safe and dry, so they do not make mistakes or get hurt.
   Working / marking points: One mark for staying safe, one for avoiding mistakes, one for a clear link to rain.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: small, black, thin, new, flat (any two).
   Working / marking points: One mark for each sensible adjective.

21. (3 marks)
   Answer: Greet, give your name, speak clearly, do not interrupt, do not call late without a reason, say goodbye.
   Working / marking points: One mark for each.
